changes.summary: `@capability` gains an optional invocation section, and `@agent-profile` gains optional invocation and presentation sections and `execution.effort`, so a Claude, Codex or Grok plugin can be lowered into records and rendered back; existing records remain valid and IA syntax remains 1.0.
No content change; exact dependency versions on changed public systems, including inventarch/workspace-system, move to 3.1.0. IA syntax remains 1.0.

Reference guides for `@capability`, `@agent-profile` and `@distribution` document the new optional invocation, presentation and product fields; exact dependency versions move to 3.1.0. IA syntax remains 1.0.
